testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle extended feature names in the browser: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:85:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle extended feature names in the browser ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active part in the MCAD Software contains a 20 mm new-solid extrusion ✔ And Show Extended Names is disabled in the model browser display preferences ✔ When the user enables Show Extended Names from the browser display preferences ✔ Then the extrusion row includes its new-solid operation and 20 mm extent after its name ✔ And the block remains visible in the same apparent view ✔ When the user reopens the browser display preferences ✔ Then Show Extended Names is checked ✔ When the user chooses Show Extended Names again ✔ Then the extrusion row returns to its shorter name ✔ And the block remains visible in the same apparent view
